scenario.yaml 881 B · 33 ln

---
id: cni-cilium-ebpf-kube-proxy-replacement
name: "Cilium eBPF kube-proxy replacement"
description: "Proves full eBPF kube-proxy replacement on kind: Cilium replaces kube-proxy, product ClusterIP reachable through eBPF datapath."
labels: {customer: any, profile: cni}
cluster:
  provider: kind
  config: ./fixtures/kind-cilium.yaml
  cni:
    provider: cilium
    kube_proxy_replacement: true
product:
  chart: ./chart
  release: sample
  namespace: sample
  set:
    image.repository: "public.ecr.aws/nginx/nginx"
    image.tag: "1.27-alpine"
    ingress.enabled: "false"
asserts:
  - type: helm-status-deployed
    release: sample
    namespace: sample
  - type: pods-ready
    namespace: sample
    timeout: 5m
  - type: smoke-script
    path: chart-test/assertions/cni/cilium-ebpf.sh
tags: [nightly]
mechanisms: ['addon:cilium']
category: cni
integration: cilium
tier: live

      # -- Filesystem path where TLS cert+key are mounted. Defaults to /etc/tls.
      mountPath: "",
      # -- Volume type for the TLS material. Supported: secret (default), persistentVolumeClaim, projected, csi.
      volumeType: "secret",
      # -- PVC claim name (required when volumeType is persistentVolumeClaim).
      pvcClaimName: "",
      # -- SecretProviderClass name (required when volumeType is csi).
      secretProviderClass: "",
      # -- Whether to run the wait-for-tls initContainer that polls for cert files. Disable for CSI volumes that are populated asynchronously.
      waitForCerts: true},
    # -- Scope component (API server). Creates a separate Deployment + Service on port 8080.
    scope: {enabled: false, replicaCount: 1, image: {repository: nginx, tag: "1.27-alpine"}, service: {port: 8080}},
    # -- Darkroom component (async processor). Creates a separate Deployment with optional PVC mount.

    # -- Ingress resource for skywatcher Service.

---
id: cni-cilium-ingress
name: "Cilium ingress controller — dedicated loadbalancerMode"
description: "Proves the Cilium ingress controller in dedicated loadbalancerMode on kind: per-Ingress Service routes HTTP with matching Host header to the product Service."
labels: {customer: any, profile: cni}
cluster:
  provider: kind
  config: ./fixtures/kind-cilium.yaml
  cni:
    provider: cilium
    kube_proxy_replacement: true
    values: ./fixtures/cilium-ingress-values.yaml
product:
  chart: ./chart
  release: sample
  namespace: sample
  set:
    image.repository: "public.ecr.aws/nginx/nginx"
    image.tag: "1.27-alpine"
    ingress.enabled: "true"
    ingress.className: "cilium"
    ingress.host: "sample.test.local"
asserts:
  - type: helm-status-deployed
    release: sample
    namespace: sample
  - type: pods-ready
    namespace: sample
    timeout: 5m
  - type: smoke-script
    path: chart-test/assertions/cni/cilium-ingress.sh
tags: [nightly]
mechanisms: ['addon:cilium']
category: cni
integration: cilium
tier: live

---
id: cni-cilium-network-policy
name: "CiliumNetworkPolicy enforcement — default-deny + allow-by-label"
description: "Proves CiliumNetworkPolicy (CNP) enforcement on kind: default-deny + allow-by-label. Blocks unlabeled traffic; allows labeled clients. CNP applied as raw_manifest preinstall."
labels: {customer: any, profile: cni}
cluster:
  provider: kind
  config: ./fixtures/kind-cilium.yaml
  cni:
    provider: cilium
    kube_proxy_replacement: true
  preinstall:
    - kind: raw_manifest
      path: ./fixtures/cilium-network-policy.yaml
      namespace: sample
product:
  chart: ./chart
  release: sample
  namespace: sample
  set:
    image.repository: "public.ecr.aws/nginx/nginx"
    image.tag: "1.27-alpine"
    ingress.enabled: "false"
asserts:
  - type: helm-status-deployed
    release: sample
    namespace: sample
  - type: pods-ready
    namespace: sample
    timeout: 5m
  - type: smoke-script
    path: chart-test/assertions/cni/cilium-network-policy.sh
tags: [nightly]
mechanisms: ['addon:cilium']
category: cni
integration: cilium
tier: live

---
# CiliumNetworkPolicy fixture for cni-cilium-network-policy scenario.
# Enforces:
#   - Default-deny ingress to the product Service (drop all unmatched traffic)
#   - Allow ingress only from pods carrying label access=allowed
apiVersion: "cilium.io/v2"
kind: CiliumNetworkPolicy
metadata:
  name: cncp-sample
  namespace: sample
spec:
  endpointSelector:
    matchLabels:
      app.kubernetes.io/instance: sample
  ingress:
    # Allow from pods with label access=allowed (same namespace)
    - fromEndpoints:
        - matchLabels:
            access: allowed
      toPorts:
        - ports:
            - port: "80"
              protocol: TCP
